text: Philadelphia led after two periods of a game it barely controlled, and Carolina took the win it had earned. Shayne Gostisbehere ended it on a power-play slap shot at 2:51 of overtime, set up by Jackson Blake and Sebastian Aho. CAR 3, PHI 2 fit how the game was played: Carolina had 79 shot attempts to 43, 4.79 expected goals to 2.83, and deserved to win 78 percent of simulated replays.
